description: This file defines the RowDimension class, which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages row properties such as index, height, and zero-height status within a worksheet.

classes.name: RowDimension
classes.description: Represents the dimensions (height, index, zero-height flag) of a row in a spreadsheet worksheet. Provides methods to get and set row height, index, and zero height status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RowDimension with an optional row index.

methods.name: getRowHeight
methods.description: Returns the row height, optionally converting it to the specified unit of measure.

methods.name: setRowHeight
methods.description: Sets the row height, converting from the specified unit of measure if provided.

methods.name: getZeroHeight
methods.description: Returns whether the row has zero height.

methods.name: setZeroHeight
methods.description: Sets whether the row has zero height.
